description: Concept search when you do NOT know the symbol name: free text ("retry handling") -> ranked symbols (identifier/file/domain token match, stemmed, weighted by exports/role/fan-in). Deterministic, no embeddings. Start here when orienting; feed the top id to codeweb_explain.

full.description: Return the unabridged result (disables the default budget). Large on big repos.

graph.description: Path to graph.json. OPTIONAL — defaults to CODEWEB_WS or the nearest .codeweb/graph.json above cwd

limit.description: Max items to return (each tool has a sensible default; full:true disables)

offset.description: Skip N items (page through a budgeted list via more.nextOffset)

query.description: Free-text concept ("retry backoff", "where is config parsed") — no symbol name needed

name: codeweb_find
